We think limiting the dogs' roaming would be better for their health and safety. Fights or disease transmission between animals would be unacceptable. I wouldn't feel comfortable weighing my cat there, so I didn't.

I like that they offer 24-hour service. I'm already a member on my phone.
I'll definitely use their service again if I have the chance.
